templates.title: Gaussian Blur
templates.description: Blur the current image; sigma in pixels.

templates.title: Median...
templates.description: Radius in pixels.

templates.title: Despeckle
templates.description: Remove salt-and-pepper noise (median-based).

templates.title: Bandpass Filter...
templates.description: Suppress large and small structures (FFT-style); tune min/max structure sizes for your sample.
templates.macro: run("Bandpass Filter...", "filter_large structures down to=40 filter_small structures up to=3 suppress=None tolerance=autoscaling");

templates.title: Kalman Stack Filter
templates.description: Light temporal smoothing for time-lapse or Z-series (adjust gain/bias).

templates.title: Subtract Background...
templates.description: Rolling ball background subtraction.

templates.title: Enhance Contrast...
templates.description: Histogram stretch with saturation fraction (0–100).

templates.title: Auto Threshold
templates.description: Global auto threshold (method name varies by ImageJ version).

templates.title: Watershed
templates.description: Separate touching particles on binary mask.

templates.title: Fill Holes
templates.description: Fill interior holes in a binary mask.

templates.title: Analyze Particles...
templates.description: Measure/count particles on binary mask.
templates.macro: run("Analyze Particles...", "size=50-Infinity circularity=0.00-1.00 show=Outlines display summarize");

templates.title: Measure
templates.description: Record measurements for ROI or entire image to Results.

templates.title: Clear Results
templates.description: Empty the Results table.

templates.title: Image Calculator...
templates.description: Multiply two open images (e.g. colocalization-style product image). Replace ImageA and ImageB with exact window titles from list_open_images.

templates.title: 3D Objects Counter
templates.description: Count/measure 3D objects in a stack (requires plugin in some builds; verify with search_commands).

templates.title: RGB Color
templates.description: Convert composite/multichannel display to RGB stack.

templates.title: Duplicate...
templates.description: Duplicate the active image before destructive steps.

templates.title: Scale Bar...
templates.description: Add a scale bar overlay (adjust width_in_cm / font).
templates.macro: run("Scale Bar...", "width=5 height=4 font=18 color=White background=None location=[Lower Right] bold");

templates.title: Set Scale...
templates.description: Spatial calibration: here 100 pixels span 45 microns—edit distance/known/pixel/unit for your data.

templates.title: Split Channels
templates.description: Split the active composite hyperstack into separate channel images.

templates.title: Merge Channels...
templates.description: Combine channels into a composite. Replace C1-MyStack / C2-MyStack with exact titles from list_open_images after Split Channels.
templates.macro: run("Merge Channels...", "c1=C1-MyStack c2=C2-MyStack c3=C3-MyStack create composite");

templates.title: Z Project...
templates.description: Max-intensity projection along Z.

templates.title: Z Project... (mean)
templates.description: Average-intensity projection along Z.

templates.title: Z Project... (sum)
templates.description: Sum slices along Z (brightfield-style absorption sometimes uses sum).

templates.title: Orthogonal Views
templates.description: Open xz/yz orthogonal views for the current stack.

templates.title: Coloc 2
templates.description: Fiji Coloc 2 colocalization analysis (requires Coloc 2; uses wizard selections).

templates.title: TrackMate
templates.description: Single-particle tracking UI (requires TrackMate).

templates.title: Cellpose Prediction
templates.description: Cellpose segmentation UI if a Cellpose Fiji plugin is installed—command name varies; confirm with search_commands.

templates.title: CLIJ2 Macro Extensions
templates.description: Initialize CLIJ2 for macro calls (requires CLIJ2; GPU device string may need tuning).

templates.title: Marker-controlled Watershed
templates.description: MorphoLibJ watershed from marker image (requires MorphoLibJ).

templates.title: Morphological Segmentation
templates.description: MorphoLibJ morphological segmentation UI (requires MorphoLibJ).
